3) No-inference check
- All required fields have explicit values in document; no inferred/missing required fields detected.

4) Multiple occurrences rule

5) Final mapping (to be output as JSON in next step)

- Invoice.Date = "03.01.2024"
- Sender.VatId = "ATU16378408"
- Vat.Rate = 20,00 (store as numeric 20)
